items.title: McDonald's (MCD) Is Testing Value Bundles In Nearly 2,000 U.S. Restaurants
items.summary: McDonald's (NYSE:MCD) is testing new value menu bundles across nearly 2,000 U.S. restaurants to appeal to cost-conscious diners. The trial forms part of a broader plan to roll out a national value platform in early 2027 across the domestic system. Management is using the pilot to assess how bundled value offers influence guest traffic levels and customer ordering behavior.
